7 انحجز quasi-pass. of حَجَزَهُ in the first of the senses explained above; (TA;) He, or it, was, or became, prevented, hindered, impeded, withheld, restrained, or debarred; he withheld, or restrained, himself; he refrained, forbore, or abstained. (S, K, TA.) ―
-b2- انحجز عَنْهُ He left, forsook, or relinquished, it. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also 6. ＝
-A2- See also 8.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
